title: MINOTAUR: Multi-task Video Grounding From Multimodal Queries

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: In light of this, we present MINOTAUR, a uniﬁed multitask model that is designed to accept long videos and multimodal queries as input, and generate diverse structured outputs.

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: These tasks differ in the type of inputs (only video, or video-query pair where query is an image region or sentence) and outputs (temporal segments or spatio-temporal tubes).

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: We exhaustively analyze relationships among the tasks and illustrate that cross-task learning leads to improved performance on each individual task, as well as the ability to generalize to unseen tasks, such as zero-shot spatial localization of language queries. # Abstract Video understanding tasks take many forms, from action detection to visual query localization and spatio-temporal grounding of sentences.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: These tasks differ in the type of inputs (only video, or video-query pair where query is an image region or sentence) and outputs (temporal segments or spatio-temporal tubes).

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: In particular, our model can address all three tasks of the Ego4D Episodic Memory benchmark which entail queries of three different forms: given an egocentric video and a visual, textual or activity query, the goal is to determine when and where the answer can be seen within the video.
